_meta.indication: TAFINLAR is a kinase inhibitor indicated for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with BRAF V600E mutation as detected by an FDA-approved test; not indicated for wild-type BRAF melanoma.

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, international, open-label, randomized (3:1), active-controlled trial comparing single-agent dabrafenib to dacarbazine (DTIC)
pivotal_trials.population: 250 patients with previously untreated BRAF V600E mutation-positive, unresectable or metastatic melanoma
pivotal_trials.result: Median PFS 5.1 months (95% CI 4.9, 6.9) vs 2.7 months (95% CI 1.5, 3.2); HR 0.33 (95% CI 0.20, 0.54); P<0.0001. Objective response rate 52% vs 17%.

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥20%): hyperkeratosis, headache, pyrexia, arthralgia, papilloma, alopecia, and palmar-plantar erythrodysesthesia syndrome. Principal serious risks are new primary cutaneous malignancies (cuSCC 11% across trials; 7% in Trial 1) and serious febrile drug reactions (3.7% in Trial 1).
target_moa: Dabrafenib is an inhibitor of some mutated forms of BRAF kinases (including BRAF V600E, V600K, V600D); constitutively activated mutant BRAF kinases stimulate tumor cell growth, and dabrafenib inhibits BRAF V600 mutation-positive melanoma cell growth.

rems.type: A REMS was determined not to be required to ensure safe use of dabrafenib; a Medication Guide was recommended.

companion_dx_detail: At the time of review, a premarket approval application for the bioMerieux THxID BRAF Kit (PMA P120014) was under review in CDRH, intended for use as an in vitro companion diagnostic assay to detect BRAF V600 (E or K) mutations in melanoma to aid selection of patients for treatment with dabrafenib.

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee was convened; the NDA was not referred to ODAC because this is not the first drug in its class, there were no issues with trial design or primary endpoint, and no novel issues needing committee expertise.

description.text: Added indication for dabrafenib in combination with trametinib for unresectable or metastatic melanoma with BRAF V600E or V600K mutations (accelerated approval)

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application proposes to include a new indication for Tafinlar (dabrafenib), in combination with trametinib, for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with BRAF V600E or V600K mutations as detected by an FDA-approved test. This indication is based on the demonstration of durable response rate. Improvement in disease-related symptoms or overall survival has not been demonstrated for TAFINLAR in combination with trametinib

description.text: Converted accelerated approval to regular approval for dabrafenib in combination with trametinib for unresectable or metastatic melanoma with BRAF V600E or V600K mutations, removing the durable-response-rate limitation statement

citations.quote: This “Prior Approval” supplemental new drug application provides regular approval of dabrafenib, in combination with trametinib, for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with BRAF V600E or V600K mutations as detected by an FDA-approved test and to remove the statement from the currently approved indication “The use in combination is based on the demonstration of durable response rate. Improvement in disease-related symptoms or overall survival has not been demonstrated for TAFINLAR in combination with trametinib.”

description.text: Added Clinical Studies data for dabrafenib plus trametinib in BRAF mutation-positive melanoma metastatic to the brain (COMBI-MB study)

description.text: Revised Clinical Studies section with updated efficacy data for BRAF V600E anaplastic thyroid cancer (no new indication; labeling data update)

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application revises the CLINICAL STUDIES, BRAF V600E Mutation-Positive Locally Advanced or Metastatic Anaplastic Thyroid Cancer (14.5) subsection with updated patient characteristics, overall response rate, and duration of response data.

description.text: Added tissue-agnostic accelerated approval for Tafinlar with trametinib in adult and pediatric patients 6 years and older with unresectable/metastatic BRAF V600E-mutant solid tumors after prior treatment

citations.quote: *TAFINLAR is indicated, in combination with trametinib, for the treatment of adult and pediatric patients 6 years of age and older with unresectable or metastatic solid tumors with BRAF V600E mutation who have progressed following prior treatment and have no satisfactory alternative treatment options. This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on overall response rate and duration of response. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in a confirmatory trial(s).*

description.text: Labeling update adding long-term duration of response and overall response rate follow-up data for BRAF V600E-positive metastatic NSCLC; no new indication (fulfilled postmarketing commitment).

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application revises the CLINICAL STUDIES, BRAF V600E Mutation-Positive Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (14.4) subsection with additional follow-up for duration of response (DOR) in patients who received dabrafenib as a single agent or in combination with trametinib and were considered responders in Study BRF113928 at the time of the initial approval. Additionally, the overall response rate (ORR) results and categorizations of best overall response were updated for patients who were previously treated and received dabrafenib in combination with trametinib. Similarly, the categorizations of best overall response were updated for patients who were treatment-naïve prior to receiving dabrafenib in combination with trametinib.

description.text: Added treatment of pediatric patients 1 year of age and older with low-grade glioma with a BRAF V600E mutation who require systemic therapy

citations.quote: This Prior Approval sNDA provides for the use of Tafinlar (dabrafenib) capsules for the treatment of pediatric patients 1 year of age and older with low-grade glioma with a BRAF V600E mutation who require systemic therapy.

description.text: Extended the tumor agnostic indication age range from patients 6 years and older to patients 1 year and older

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides updates to the Tafinlar (dabrafenib) Prescribing Information (PI) and the Medication Guide extending the age range of the tumor agnostic indication from patients aged 6 years of age and older to patients aged 1 year of age and older.

description.text: Added overall survival data from COMBI-AD trial for dabrafenib in combination with trametinib in adjuvant treatment of BRAF V600 mutation-positive melanoma (labeling update, PMC fulfillment)

basis.text: FDA designated dabrafenib a Fast Track program for treatment of BRAF mutation-positive (V600E) advanced melanoma on February 11, 2011.

summary.text: Dabrafenib received Fast Track designation (February 11, 2011) and Orphan Drug designation (January 12, 2011) for BRAF V600 mutation-positive advanced melanoma, and was granted regular (full) approval based on a statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in progression-free survival in the randomized BRF113683 (BREAK-3) trial; the application was not referred to an advisory committee.

citations.quote: February 11, 2011: FDA designated as a Fast Track program the investigation of GSK2118436 (dabrafenib) for the treatment of patients with BRAF mutation positive (V600E(b) (4)) advanced melanoma.
January 12, 2011: FDA granted Orphan Drug designation for dabrafenib for the treatment of BRAF V600 mutation positive Stage IIb through IV melanoma.
